title: Measles reaches school in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania
detail: Measles reached a school in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania, as the ongoing US outbreak continues to accelerate. The western Pennsylvania county, home to Pittsburgh, adds a new geographic front to the state's expanding outbreak, which already leads the nation in 2026 case counts with over 676 cases across 37 counties.

title: CDC weekly update: 4,080 confirmed measles cases in 2026
detail: CDC's Oct 9 update (data through Oct 8) reports 4,080 confirmed 2026 cases across 47 jurisdictions, up 193 (5.0%) in a week, 78% above the 2,289 cases in all of 2025. 42 new outbreaks have been reported; 96% of cases are outbreak-associated and 414 (10%) were hospitalized. CDC confirms 2 deaths in 2026 while states report 5 in Pennsylvania alone.
